tagline: Come curious. Leave with more questions.

hero.headline: COME CURIOUS.
hero.subheadline: Fieldstone is an independent K–12 school for students who like to ask why. School is not just desks and schedules. It is experiments, arguments, mistakes, and ideas you cannot stop thinking about on the bus ride home.

offerings.name: MUSIC
offerings.description: Acoustic strings, percussion, brass & unexpected harmonies.

offerings.name: SPORT
offerings.description: Courtyard soccer, cross-country runs & breathless team play.

offerings.name: ART
offerings.description: Oils, charcoal, ceramic wheels & oversized canvas paper.

offerings.name: BOOKS
offerings.description: Deep reading, worn anthologies & quiet sunny corners.

offerings.name: BUILDING
offerings.description: Timber joints, circuit boards, bridges & prototypes.

values.title: THINK FOR YOURSELF.
values.description: Question assumptions. Examine the evidence. Form convictions that are truly your own.

values.title: TRY THINGS.
values.description: Build the fragile prototype. Sing the chord. Make the bold mistake that teaches you something.

values.title: CARE ABOUT OTHER PEOPLE.
values.description: Listen with patience. Disagree with generosity. Leave the room kinder than you found it.

meta_title: Fieldstone Independent School | Seattle, WA (K–12) — Come Curious
meta_description: Fieldstone is an independent K–12 school in Seattle for students who like to ask why. Not just classrooms and schedules, but questions, experiments, friendships, and discoveries.
